channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Sean Marks | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Sean Marks from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nic Claxton on Sean Marks
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Nic Claxton on if he goes to #Nets GM Sean Marks about trade rumors:

“I've almost been traded before. Sean, he has an open-door policy. You can always go talk to him whenever you want; but that's for my agents to take care of. I'm just here as long as I'm here.”

Nic Claxton on Sean Marks, Jan 23, 2026. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Cam Johnson on Sean Marks
item.description:
Brooklyn Nets forward Cam Johnson on potential trade talks:

“Definitely go to him (Sean Marks) and ask because I have a very vested interest in what we’re doing here. I feel like I’ve put a lot of effort into trying to be a part of this program and I take that very seriously.”

Cam Johnson on Sean Marks, Apr 14, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Sean Marks
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on his communication with Sean Marks at the deadline:

“The owner has a vision, the GM designs the whole plan, and then the coaches execute on the court…I’m always informed about what’s gonna happen and what’s happening, and that gives me security to then do my job…We always have opinions and share opinions. I've been building a very good relationship with the front office.”

Jordi Fernandez on Sean Marks, Feb 7, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Sean Marks
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez:

“I think Sean (Marks) said it. I was going through a process. We know that we wanted to do something sustainable, and we wanted to win and build something very special. There were different avenues to do it, and this was a possible one. We just could not control what other teams would offer, so we would have to sit and wait. He had different avenues to get there. When the opportunity presented itself, he called me, and I knew before it came out to the media. I was very excited because I know how the NBA works, and I know how good you can get when you have assets, flexibility, and so forth. I’m just very excited.”

Jordi Fernandez on Sean Marks, Jul 12, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Mikal Bridges on Sean Marks
item.description:
“Sean Marks is a really good dude. I like ’em a lot. I don’t know, you hear the whole thing about what’s going on in Brooklyn and how people don’t like this and that. But I’m just like, these people are great. They’re great people.”

Mikal Bridges on Sean Marks, May 19, 2023. Source: hoopherald.com.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Sean Marks, Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jacque Vaughn on Kyrie Irving:

“There's a business side to this thing and there's a human side to this thing. I elected to touch on the human side and check on him as an individual. I'll leave the business side to Sean (Marks, GM) and that group.”

Jacque Vaughn on Sean Marks, Kyrie Irving, Feb 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Sean Marks
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Kevin Durant:

“I did like what Sean (Marks) put together with the team(this offseason).”

Kevin Durant on Sean Marks, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Sean Marks
item.description:
“Sean [Marks, Nets general manager] will hit me, like, ‘Goran is interested, what you think?’ I [contacted] him. That’s always who I’ve been since I got here. I’ve never had control. I don’t want it. “I don’t want to know because I’m the ‘franchise player,’ it’s just the fact I want to know who my teammates are. It’s disrespectful for me to come and try to override what they do because of my status in the league. That’s not fair to them. Everybody has a career. I just want to know.”

Kevin Durant on Sean Marks, Apr 26, 2022. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Steve Nash, Sean Marks
item.description:
Why did you choose Brooklyn over LA?Blake Griffin:

“They have a need for a 4-man. I’ve always had a lot of respect for Steve Nash and all of the guys they have. Sean Marks has done a great job there. It was a tough decision and I wanted to be on a team that was contending.”

Blake Griffin on Steve Nash, Sean Marks, Mar 8, 2021. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Sean Marks
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Spencer Dinwiddie on how being his own agent changes his talks w/ GM Sean Marks over trade rumors:

“Whatever they do from a front office perspective, they’re going to do. My job is to help win games.”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Sean Marks, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Steve Nash, Sean Marks
item.description:
“But in this situation, he’s only one of the most qualified basketball players of all time and is friends with the stars of our team and the GM of the team [Sean Marks, who played with Nash in Phoenix]. It kind of makes sense beyond the fact that he doesn’t have coaching experience.”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Steve Nash, Sean Marks, Sep 11, 2020. Source: Forbes.com.

item.title: Jerry Colangelo on Sean Marks
item.description:
“He didn’t create [the disproportionate number of Black coaches in the NBA]. He was offered an opportunity, and he’s a big boy, he understood what saying ‘Yes’ might cause or create certain kinds of speculation. But he was willing to do that. Certainly the same with [Nets GM Sean Marks], he knew in hiring Steve he knew he was potentially opening himself up. But he chose to do it. And so you have to honor that. We’re just living in a very precarious time and every decision is looked at with a microscope and race is brought into it. Sometimes it’s justified, sometimes it’s not.”

Jerry Colangelo on Sean Marks, Sep 7, 2020. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Channing Frye on Steve Nash, Sean Marks
item.description:
Frye, now a TNT analyst, said in an interview.

“If this was the only job that was available then for sure, maybe this is a case of white privilege. But knowing that these other jobs are open, it’s pretty dang amazing.“Would I like to see more diversity as head coaches? Obviously. But in this case, I just don’t see that, knowing Sean Marks, knowing Steve Nash, I just don’t think this is that situation.”

Channing Frye on Steve Nash, Sean Marks, Sep 5, 2020. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Sean Marks
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on being evaluated by #Nets GM Sean Marks:

“You can be examined by different eyes. That’s why it was so important that I showcase who I am…I hope every man in that locker room said I was authentic.”

Jacque Vaughn on Sean Marks, Aug 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Sean Marks
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jacque Vaughn on what he's heard from #Nets GM Sean Marks:

“We just carry on every day. I show up, coach this team, really embrace this moment. No conversations besides what I had for breakfast, and we’ll keep it that simple.”

Jacque Vaughn on Sean Marks, Aug 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Tyler Johnson on Sean Marks
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Tyler Johnson on finally joining the #Nets after signing a 4-year, $50 million RFA offer sheet four years ago:

“My mom still says Sean Marks is one of her favorite people ever.”

Tyler Johnson on Sean Marks, Jul 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Josepth Tsai on Sean Marks
item.description:
with Tsai and his philanthropic investor wife Clara, as they get to know him better.

“I know that we’ve got incredibly popular players. It’s not like the minute we sign them I call up [GM] Sean Marks and say I need KD’s phone number,”

Josepth Tsai on Sean Marks, Oct 9, 2019. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Charles Oakley on Sean Marks
item.description:
“Sean Marks has done a great job. The Nets have better pieces. You get Kyrie and K.D. or Kyrie and Kawhi and you have something. They have nothing bad going on with them. If Kyrie and K.D. come to the Knicks, it wouldn’t be enough. The Nets are winning. They’re not blowing teams out but they’re competing. The ball moves. You come to the Knicks … it won’t be easy.”

Charles Oakley on Sean Marks, Mar 12, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Sean Marks
item.description:
Dinwiddie:

“Simultaneously, I know you guys will say that it's an audition for 29 other teams — 28 depending upon how you look at Detroit, maybe 27 depending upon how you look at Chicago (smiles). So, it is what it is. Either I'm going to sign an extension or I'm going to become an unrestricted free agent. It's pretty much as simple as that. The ball is very much in Sean Marks' and the Nets' court. Everybody knows what my extension number is four (years) for $47.5 million. It is well documented. You can't go above. It's not like I'm really looking to go below (smiles and laughs).”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Sean Marks, Dec 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Joe Harris on Sean Marks, Kenny Atkinson
item.description:
Joe Harris said,

“We're trying to be as involved in the Brooklyn community as possible. That's been a focal point from the moment that Sean Marks and Kenny Atkinson got here.”

Joe Harris on Sean Marks, Kenny Atkinson, Oct 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Sean Marks
item.description:
“I want to be here. I love being here, so I’m happy that they didn’t (trade him). On the flip side, the fact that the spectrum of teams that were calling means that, obviously, I played well. Because I’ve been on the other side of that situation, where obviously nobody really cared what I was doing. It’s cool in that respect. I guess mildly stressful, but at the same time I can’t control it, so it doesn’t really matter. If Sean (Marks) tells me that I’ve got to go to Phoenix tomorrow, then I’ve got to pack my bags and go to Phoenix. This is nothing I control.”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Sean Marks, Sep 28, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Brett Brown on Sean Marks
item.description:
“We went overboard with development, we went overboard with relationships, tried to hold the locker room together. Make them feel they had worth and help them. You blink, and five years later we’re in a pretty good spot. We’ve got a young foundation and we like the direction we’re pointing. From afar looking across the fence at this team – and Sean Marks is a very close friend of mine – they get Jeremy [Lin] healthy and the style of play,I can see they’re heading in the right direction. We’ve got respect for them.”

Brett Brown on Sean Marks, Mar 12, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: DeMarre Carroll on Mark Bartelstein, Sean Marks
item.description:
“Mark Bartelstein just told me a lot of teams are interested. He talked to [GM] Sean Marks and they value me a lot here,”

DeMarre Carroll on Mark Bartelstein, Sean Marks, Feb 4, 2018. Source: New York Post.

item.title: DeMarre Carroll on Sean Marks
item.description:
“He affects the game in a lot of different ways, and a lot of people would love to have him. But I know Sean Marks and Kenny value him big-time. I know for sure they’re not trying to trade him. There’s always conversations around the league and anything can happen, but I know the Brooklyn Nets put a great value on DeMarre . . . I want to make sure people realize that.”

DeMarre Carroll on Sean Marks, Jan 24, 2018. Source: Newsday.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Sean Marks
item.description:
“We’ve got to see how things play out with everything, butI do think [Marks and I] both agree that we don’t want to go in with a totally young roster. We do need that veteran support. If it’s the right position where somebody can help us, it’s definitely something [to consider].”

Kenny Atkinson on Sean Marks, Jul 9, 2017. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Sean Marks
item.description:
“They're going to get things changed. They've got a great coaching staff and with Sean (Marks) as the new GM, they'll get things turned around. It takes time; you have to be patient. It's not always fixable by one player. It takes a team.”

Jason Kidd on Sean Marks, Feb 16, 2017. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Sean Kilpatrick on Sean Marks
item.description:
Kilpatrick told Basketball Insiders.

“I said, ‘Who is this?’ He said, ‘It’s Sean Marks.’ I said ‘From where?’ He said, ‘The Brooklyn Nets. Are you ready to play?’ I said, ‘Yeah I’m ready, I’m ready. What do you want me to do?’ He was like, ‘Meet us in L.A.I’ve sent everything, just meet us there.’ I ended up going to L.A. and as soon as I got to L.A., I just played.”

Sean Kilpatrick on Sean Marks, Dec 2, 2016. Source: Basketball Insiders.

item.title: Sean Kilpatrick on Sean Marks
item.description:
Kilpatrick told Basketball Insiders.

“It’s like my emotions toward Mr. Marks are kind of crazy because I always say he saved my life, and he did. He really sat here and said, ‘This is a team I want you to be a part of, and just make sure you just play your game and be who you are.’ I think that’s something no team has ever done for me and once I had that type of comfort, it made things a lot easier for me.”

Sean Kilpatrick on Sean Marks, Dec 2, 2016. Source: Basketball Insiders.

item.title: Thaddeus Young on Sean Marks
item.description:
“I think Sean [Marks] did a good job of facilitating that trade and being able to get a young assetfor a veteran guy who can go out and be able to compete on a playoff team.”

Thaddeus Young on Sean Marks, Oct 29, 2016. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Trevor Booker on Sean Marks
item.description:
Trevor Booker:

“Brooklyn was one of the teams pursuing me from the beginning and I knew [Nets general manager] Sean Marks because we had a short stint together in Washington when he was still playing. I know what kind of a guy he is and what kind of an organization he came from with the Spurs, which is an A-1 organization. Coach [Kenny] Atkinson came from a great organization in Atlanta too. After doing a little research on him, I was comfortable with him and I was comfortable with the whole situation. I bought into what they are doing.”

Trevor Booker on Sean Marks, Oct 10, 2016. Source: Basketball Insiders.
